errors.VALIDATION: Some information is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: This request is not allowed from this page.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
errors.CONFLICT: The data changed or needs recovery. Refresh the data and check the workbook status.
errors.WORKBOOK_CHANGED: The workbook changed outside this operation. Refresh the data and try again.
errors.WORKBOOK_BUSY: Another Finance process is using this workbook. Wait for it to finish and try again.
errors.WORKBOOK_EXISTS: A workbook already exists. Restart Finance.
errors.WORKBOOK_LINK: The workbook must be a regular file without links.
errors.EXCEL_OPEN: The workbook is open in Excel. Close it and try again.
errors.EXTERNAL_SERVICE: The Central Bank rate service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Finance could not save the workbook. Check folder access and available disk space.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Finance could not process this request. Check the workbook status.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The selected file or request is too large.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This file format is not supported.
errors.EMPTY_UPLOAD: Choose an Excel workbook to upload.
errors.RECOVERY_EMPTY: Choose a Finance ZIP archive to verify.
errors.RECOVERY_TOO_LARGE: The recovery archive is larger than 256 MB. Choose a smaller archive.
errors.RECOVERY_INVALID: The archive is damaged or uses an incompatible format.
errors.RECOVERY_HASH_MISMATCH: The workbook checksum in the archive does not match.
errors.RECOVERY_WORKBOOK_INVALID: The archive does not contain a valid Finance workbook.
errors.OPERATION_TYPE_IMMUTABLE: An operation type cannot be changed. Delete the entry and create a new one with the correct type.
errors.LINKED_MOVEMENT_MISMATCH: The linked savings movement is inconsistent. No changes were made.
errors.SHUTTING_DOWN: Finance is finishing current work and shutting down.
errors.WORKBOOK_MISSING_SHEET: The workbook is missing a required sheet. Choose a Finance workbook with Operations, Lists, Balance, and Summary sheets.
errors.WORKBOOK_INVALID: Finance could not verify this workbook. Choose a supported .xlsx file. The source file was not changed.
errors.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.UPDATE_INSTALL_UNAVAILABLE: Update installation is available only in the packaged Windows version of Finance.
errors.UPDATE_INSTALL_PENDING: The update installer is already running.
errors.UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Could not download and verify the installer. The app and your data were not changed.
errors.ROLLBACK_UNAVAILABLE: The previous Finance version is not available for rollback.
